Display-Jumbo-Regular.$description:
Landing-page hero headline only. Use once per page, above the fold — it's the largest, most expressive text in the system and loses impact if repeated.

Formerly "display/Jumbo".
Sizes: mobile 72px · tablet 87px · desktop 125px

Display-XLarge-Regular.$description:
Large landing-page section headline, one step down from a Jumbo hero. Use to open a major section on a marketing page.

New tier, added for LOHP's H2.
Sizes: mobile 60px · tablet 72px · desktop 104px

Display-Large-Regular.$description:
Landing-page section headline for content that doesn't need Jumbo/XLarge's full weight, but is still bigger than in-app text.

New tier, added for LOHP's H3.
Sizes: mobile 50px · tablet 60px · desktop 87px

Display-Large-Emphasis.$description:
Landing-page section headline for content that doesn't need Jumbo/XLarge's full weight, but is still bigger than in-app text.

New tier, added for LOHP's H3.
Sizes: mobile 50px · tablet 60px · desktop 87px

Display-Medium-Regular.$description:
Works on both web and app: the standard H1 for a web page, or a strong hero title in-app. Verified against real production (kasamba.com H1).

No previous app equivalent.
Sizes: mobile 42px · tablet 42px · desktop 50px

Display-Medium-Emphasis.$description:
Works on both web and app: the standard H1 for a web page, or a strong hero title in-app. Verified against real production (kasamba.com H1).

No previous app equivalent.
Sizes: mobile 42px · tablet 42px · desktop 50px

Display-Small-Regular.$description:
Largest text that appears inside the app itself — onboarding titles, empty-state headlines, hero moments within a screen.

Formerly "displayLargeTitle".
Sizes: mobile 35px · tablet 35px · desktop 42px

Display-Small-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Display/Small". Matches real code field "displayLargeTitleBold".
Sizes: mobile 35px · tablet 35px · desktop 42px

Title-Large-Regular.$description:
Primary section header within a screen — marks the start of a major content block.

Formerly "titleLarge".
Sizes: mobile 29px · tablet 29px · desktop 35px

Title-Large-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Title/Large". Matches real code field "titleLargeBold".
Sizes: mobile 29px · tablet 29px · desktop 35px

Title-Medium-Regular.$description:
Secondary section header, nested under a Title/Large — use for sub-sections.

Formerly "titleMedium".
Sizes: mobile 24px · tablet 24px · desktop 29px

Title-Medium-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Title/Medium". Matches real code field "titleMediumBold".
Sizes: mobile 24px · tablet 24px · desktop 29px

Title-Small-Regular.$description:
Compact section header — card titles, modal/dialog titles, list-section headers.

Formerly "titleSmall".
Sizes: mobile 20px · tablet 20px · desktop 24px

Title-Small-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Title/Small". Matches real code field "titleSmallBold (w600)".
Sizes: mobile 20px · tablet 20px · desktop 24px

Subtitle-Large-Regular.$description:
Supporting text directly beneath a Title, explaining what the section is about before the reader reaches Body copy.

Formerly "headline" — renamed to drop the iOS-specific term.
Sizes: 17px on all screens

Subtitle-Large-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Subtitle/Large". Matches real code field "headlineBold".
Sizes: 17px on all screens

Subtitle-Small-Regular.$description:
Same role as Subtitle/Large, used when the layout is tight (e.g. a compact card or dense list).

Formerly "subhead" — renamed to drop the iOS-specific term.
Sizes: 14px on all screens

Subtitle-Small-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Subtitle/Small". Matches real code field "subheadBold (w600)".
Sizes: 14px on all screens

Body-Large-Regular.$description:
Default reading size for paragraphs and descriptions — use this unless you have a specific reason not to.

Formerly "body". Same size as Subtitle/Large; they differ by role and weight, not size.
Sizes: 17px on all screens

Body-Large-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Body/Large". Matches real code field "bodyBold".
Sizes: 17px on all screens

Body-Small-Regular.$description:
Secondary paragraph text — de-emphasized descriptions, supporting copy next to a more important Body/Large block.

Formerly "callout" — renamed to drop the iOS-specific term.
Sizes: 12px on all screens

Body-Small-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Body/Small". Matches real code field "calloutBold (w600)".
Sizes: 12px on all screens

Caption-Large-Regular.$description:
Fine print that still needs to be comfortably readable: timestamps, metadata, helper text under a form field.

Formerly "captionLarge"; also absorbs "footnote" (13px — judged not meaningfully distinct).
Sizes: 17px on all screens

Caption-Large-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to Caption/Large. Same size and role, heavier weight for highlighted labels.
Sizes: 17px on all screens

Caption-Medium-Regular.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Caption/Large". Matches real code field "captionLargeBold (w600)".
Sizes: 14px on all screens (Purple Ocean: 12px on all screens)

Caption-Medium-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Caption/Large". Matches real code field "captionLargeBold (w600)".
Sizes: 14px on all screens (Purple Ocean: 12px on all screens)

Caption-Small-Regular.$description:
Smallest commonly-used fine print — legal disclaimers, tags, dense metadata rows.

Formerly "captionSmall".
Sizes: 10px on all screens

Caption-Small-Emphasis.$description:
Emphasis (bold) companion to "Caption/Small". Matches real code field "captionSmallBold (w600)".
Sizes: 10px on all screens
